stacking.note: Stacks over front-panel 1/10G SFP+ uplinks using standard 10G optics. Optional EX2300-VC license required. Mixes with other EX2300 models including multigigabit SKUs

routing.summary: Base license includes RIP and static routing. OSPF (and OSPFv3) need an Enhanced Feature or Flex Advanced license. No BGP on this platform

routeScale: 512 IPv4 prefixes / 4,096 host routes; 512 IPv6 prefixes / 2,048 host routes

power.summary: Fixed internal AC PSU (DC option on EX2300-24T-DC)

redundancy.detail: Fixed internal PSU; no redundant option

licensing: Juniper Flex: Standard included (RIP, static). OSPF needs Flex Advanced/Premium or the legacy EX-24-EFL / EX-48-EFL. Virtual Chassis needs EX2300-VC on 24/48-port models. Subscriptions include Mist Wired Assurance

lifecycle.note: End-of-sale announced April 30, 2026 (TSB107683). Last order September 30, 2026; support through September 30, 2031. EX4100-F is the common migration target for this class

verifyNote: Confirm TSB107683 dates and named replacements on Juniper's EX Series EOL page; third-party summaries agree on last order 2026-09-30 and support through 2031-09-30

models.note: Also sold as -24T-DC and -24T-TAA. -24T-VC includes the Virtual Chassis license
Also sold as -24P-TAA. -24P-VC includes the Virtual Chassis license

Also sold as -48P-TAA. -48P-VC includes the Virtual Chassis license. Datasheet notes 750W system PoE budget can feed 30W PoE+ on up to 24 ports or 15.4W on all 48
